blockers.problem: The Cockpit still builds its ready column, NEXT UP card and the column's '+N more' count from the stripped commandCenterLedger. That ledger (tools/board-data.mjs:120-125) keeps only id/title/status/stage/timestamps and drops dependsOn and type. cockpitLedgerRows(ledger, readyTickets) (tools/watch-assets/cockpit-lists.js:230-242) therefore treats every todo/ready row as ready. The headline tiles now read server counts, so the same screen shows two different ready sets.
blockers.exploit_or_failure: On the live project-swarm payload (ready 15, todo 61), the left column lists dependency-blocked todo tickets in the ready state. columns.left[0] can be a todo that is waiting on an unfinished dependency, but it is shown as 'NEXT UP 1 / 15' (line 561-562), even though it is not one of the 15. The overflow line built in cockpit-lists.js:257-262 shows roughly '6x ready' next to a 'ready 15' tile. Every todo ticket is counted in the 'to do 61' tile and also listed as ready. This is the 70-vs-15 divergence the tin says it removed (CHANGELOG: 'no longer ... counts every todo+ready as ready'). It has only moved from the tile into the rows.
blockers.fix: Give the client the server's dependency-aware ready set. Either keep dependsOn (plus whatever fields tools/tickets.mjs readyTickets reads, such as type/origin/approval) in commandCenterLedger, or send the ready ids (card.next.items already holds readyTickets(fullLedger)) as project.readyIds from buildProjectCockpit and pass `tickets => tickets.filter(t => readyIds.has(t.id))` as readyFn to cockpitLedgerRows and renderReadyEmptyState. Then add a cc-cockpit-mount test whose stripped ledger has a dependency-blocked todo, and assert that it is not rendered as ready or as NEXT UP.

followups.problem: The 'counts win' test can't tell its sources apart. The stripped ledger (A ready, B todo, no deps/type) goes down the readyFromStatusOnly path and gives ready 1, total 2. The counts ledger also gives ready 1, total 2. needsYou is 2 either way.
followups.exploit_or_failure: If the fallback order were reversed (ledger rows before counts), this test would still pass, so it doesn't guard the 'counts > ledger > byStatus' rule it is named for.
followups.fix: Make counts differ from what the stripped rows would produce (e.g. counts.total 9, ready 0) and assert shaped.source === 'projects[0].counts' and the counts values.

followups.problem: The cross-page parity test is tautological. The card and the cockpit both go through the same mergeCardTicketCounts over a hand-written counts stub. Nothing builds counts with board-data projectOverview/projectDetail from a real ledger, and nothing renders the Cockpit DOM with project.counts.
followups.exploit_or_failure: A regression in board-data (counts taken from a scoped or filtered ledger, or counts dropped from projectDetail), or in cc-cockpit-mount's header/tiles/footer wiring, would still pass every test. The live parity numbers in the evidence were checked by hand, not by a test.
followups.fix: Add one test that writes a fixture ledger with deps, a human ticket, cancelled and superseded rows, runs projectOverview and projectDetail, and asserts that counts equals ticketCountsOf(fullLedger) and that card.next.ready === counts.ready. Add a cc-cockpit-mount render test asserting that the header tickets/done/need-you, the tiles and the footer show project.counts values when the ledger rows disagree.

followups.problem: The Hive fixture has no `counts`, so the updated assertions (tickets4, done2 of 4, 50%, panels 8/2) exercise the ledger-rows fallback, not the canonical server path that production uses. The fixture's byStatus (failed 1, ready 1, cancelled 1) and ledger rows (4 rows) disagree, and the expectations were moved to whichever one the fallback picks.
followups.exploit_or_failure: The Hive card's counts-path rendering (counted, percentDone from ticketCounts.percentDone, snapshot.totals in panels) has no DOM-level coverage. A bug in projectView's percentDone preference or in deriveHiveView's totals branch would only show up in the vm-level parity test.
followups.fix: Give proj-a a realistic `counts` (e.g. from ticketCountsOf on its ledger plus deps/human rows) and assert the rendered card and panel numbers equal it. Keep one separate fixture without counts for the fallback.

followups.problem: headerCounters still has the old fallback that guesses need-you from ticket statuses (review + open human) when project.counts is missing. Because commandCenterLedger strips type, that fallback can't see human tickets at all.
followups.exploit_or_failure: A cockpit payload without counts (an older server, or buildProjectCockpit's 'empty' source) shows need-you = review count instead of the inbox count. That is the 8-vs-5 split the tin set out to remove.
followups.fix: In the fallback, use project.card?.blocked?.needYou (or render '—'), never a status-derived count. Do the same for total/done: prefer project.total/project.done and drop the liveTickets() guess.

followups.problem: deriveHiveView shows only snap.projects.slice(0, 10), but when snap.totals is present it uses board-wide totals over every card. Panel totals and the per-project list now cover different project sets once there are more than 10 projects.
followups.exploit_or_failure: With 11+ projects, 'tickets in the ledger' and 'tickets left to do' include projects missing from the per-project percent list, and nothing on the panel says so.
followups.fix: Either state in the panel that the totals are board-wide (e.g. 'across N projects'), or sum the visible cards when the list is truncated. Add a test with 11 projects.

summary: The server side is sound. ticketCountsOf's live set (human included; cancelled/proposed/superseded excluded), done/percent/remaining, and dependency-aware ready over the full ledger match the stated contract. board-data computes counts from the same full ledger that card.next.ready uses. mergeCardTicketCounts applies counts > ledger rows > byStatus correctly, so a payload with counts never reads byStatus. needsYou comes from card.blocked.needYou (the inbox). patchCommandCenterSnapshot rebuilds the changed cards and recomputes totals the same way a full rebuild does. Hive no longer subtracts cancelled twice. No money fields are copied into ticketCounts or the cockpit payload. Blocker: the Cockpit ready column, NEXT UP card and overflow count are still derived from the stripped ledger, which has no dependsOn. Dependency-blocked todos are therefore rendered as ready and as 'NEXT UP 1 / 15' next to a 'ready 15' tile, so the 70-vs-15 split is still visible inside the Cockpit. Follow-ups: tests that can't tell count sources apart or that check stub-vs-stub parity, a Hive DOM fixture that doesn't exercise the counts path, the legacy status-guess need-you fallback, and Hive panel totals covering more projects than the list shows. Limits: tools/tickets.mjs (readyTickets) and the board-inbox/server code were outside my readable context, so readyTickets semantics on the full ledger were inferred from callers and tests. I ran no tests.
